title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: transcript_4 _cred parameter silently ignored, confusing API
description: After the fix, transcript_4 takes _cred: &[u8] but never uses it. The call sites (lines 881, 1309, 1599) all pass credential data that is now silently discarded. For method 0 (SIGN_SIGN), this is correct behavior per RFC 9528 Section 4.1 (CRED_I should not be in TH_4), but the unused parameter and misleading argument-passing at call sites creates confusion. Either remove the parameter from the signature and update call sites, or document why it's kept for future method support.
